recipes.name: Oreo Triple Layer Chocolate Pie
ingredients_raw: 2 pkg. (4 serving size) JELL-O Chocolate Flavor Instant Pudding & Pie Filling
1 (8 ounce) tub COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed, divided

steps.text: Finely crush 24 of the cookies; mix with butter. Press firmly onto bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate.
Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk until well blended and thickened, about 2 minutes.

Spoon 1 ½ cups of chocolate pudding into crust. Gently stir 1/2 of the whipped topping into remaining pudding; spread over pudding layer in crust. Chop remaining 8 cookies; stir into remaining whipped topping. Spread over pie.
Refrigerate pie until set, about 4 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Oreo Triple Layer Chocolate Pie
raw_recipe.description: This Oreo pudding pie has a chocolate cookie crust and three chocolatey layers for a deliciously decadent no-bake pie perfect for the holidays.

review.reviewBody: Quick and easy. And delicious. For those of you having trouble with the pudding layer, make sure you do not make the pudding per the directions on the box. This recipe calls for half the milk you would normally use for two boxes of pudding. Mine set up great - pudding was very thick even before refrigerating it.

NOTE: To those of you complaining about the pie being sloppy, that's impossible unless you used too much milk. I think some people are following the pudding directions from the pudding box when they prepare it! Do not do this! It is 2 cups cold milk for both boxes! The box will tell you to use 2 cups for each pudding packet making it 4 cups milk. That is why your pie is sloppy.

This recipe is very good! Perfect consistency and this crust is way better than the packaged premade oreo crust.

I made this for a class project in FACS (which is home ec). This was sooo good. I do recommend that you use 1/2 cup of butter for the crust because 1/4 still leaves it very crumbly and not pie crust like at all. Everyone loved it so much that we had to make another one for the faculty. It is very easy. Just make sure you get instant. Follow the recipe and it turns out amazing.

This recipe was amazing! My family had nothing but great things to say about how this turned out. I'll definitely be making this again. However, I did do a few things differently. 

I have a large household, so I chose to double the recipe and make it in a cake pan. I would recommend doing so if you're making it for a large family or gathering (or if you'd like left-overs lol). 

For the crust, I was concerned about the center of the oreos making it difficult to crush finely. I chose to scrape each cookie, putting the cream in a separate bowl and blending it with the melted butter. Then, I crushed the cookies in a zip lock bag. After they were crushed well, I poured the crumbs into the cream/butter mixture. This was the ticket. The crust went together very nicely. 

Another change I made was freezing the pie (or in this case, the cake) after each layer for about 25-30 minutes. This made it very easy to add new layers without them mixing into the others (presentation is half the fun!)

I'm already getting requests to make it again, and its not gone yet. I may experiment with different flavors. Golden oreos with vanilla pudding, mint oreos with chocolate pudding...a person could have fun with this :)

This was delicious! I tweaked it a bit since a lot of people said the time for it to set was a bit long. First, I got a pack of double stuf oreo's, seperated them into two piles. The side with no cream I crushed up and used for crust. Instead of just 2 packages of chocolate pudding I added a third package of cheescake pudding and mixed all three with roughly 2 1/3 cups skim milk. I layered the filling as instructed, but before putting on the whipped cream layer I took about 6 of the cookie halves with cream and smooshed them with my fingers to make big chunks and put them on top of the second layer. Lastly I did the same smooshing with the rest of the cookie halves and mixed them in the whipped cream. Then put it all in the fridge for about an hour or two and perfection!!

Delicious! I followed the recipe, except I baked the crust at 350° for 10 minutes to solidify it, so it wouldnt crumble when sliced. And instead of Cool Whip, I made the Sturdy Whipped Cream Frosting recipe from this app. I took the pie to a party and it disappeared in minutes....
At the suggestion of another reviewer, I made this recipe again using Golden Oreos and French vanilla pudding. I actually preferred that better. it was light and creamy instead of ultra rich. But either way, this is a quick, easy, and delicious pie!

I love chocolate and Oreos so this is my dream dessert! However, I suggest anyone making this pie to make the following change: use a little more than 2 cups of milk when mixing the pudding for the first layer of the pie. I followed the recipe exactly using a premade oreo crust and instant chocolate pudding, and it was so thick it was a paste! Trying to spread this sticky pudding paste into the delicate premade Oreo pie crust is impossible! I used a rubber spatula to try and spread it around and all it did was stick to the spatula and lift/break the crust! So just add milk a little bit at a time until its the consistency of a frosting, not a paste. A creamier bottom layer will definitely save frustration and waste! Off to the store to get more ingredients and try again! Hope this helps someone!

My family LOVED the filling. I made three of these pies for the holidays. The filling always turned out perfect. I used Jello brand Devil's Food Chocolate pudding and Extra Creamy Cool Whip. Yum! For pie 3, I added an additional 1/2 cup of milk and had a fuller, 10 inch pie. I chilled the pies overnight before serving and they were great. I also used this recipe to make nine, individual layered desserts in 10 oz. plastic cups. The top layer with the blended Cool Whip and cookie crumbs was more of a garnish than a layer. Everyone loved the individual desserts

To the ppl saying that it was too runny, it is because you only used 4 servings of pudding mix. You have to use 2 boxes of the 4 servings. So the typical size is 4-1/2 so u will be using 9 servings. The person who wrote the recipe did a terrible job explaining that. They should’ve said in parenthesis (9 oz total). Good pie tho. 5 stars for pie. 2 stars for the writer.

I love this recipe! My husband is not a fan of chocolatey desserts but definitely has a sweet tooth. That being said, the first time I made this, I made 2 separate pies one exactly as written (which is delicious and wasn't runny for me at all) and the other all white. I used golden Oreos for the crust.. 2 boxes of white chocolate INSTANT pudding, and the cool whip following all the same measurements. Now, I have to say that the white versîon we liked a lot better! It was just so rich and buttery, melt in your mouth good. It's the only one I make now but I just throw in all but 6 or so cookies for the crust and use half of the pudding for the first layer and the other half mixed with half of the cool whip for the second layer. I just spread each layer right on top of the other without any issues at all...you won't regret this pie!
My granddaughter requested this pie for her birthday, I melted 1-1/2 cups of semi-chocolate and drizzled it on the crust. Also sprinkled Oreo cookie crumbs on top of the whipped topping. Delicious!
I make this exactly as it is listed. Been using this recipe for years. I make two of these every year at Thanksgiving!
Was a hit at my younger sibling's grad party!

Hi, these are some of the reviews I got for this insanely amazing pie from friends. *Hey that Oreo pie was like a religious experience. Makes all other pies like, what’s the point? *That pie is straight up orgas**c *Omg soo GOOD *This pie is amazing. - ONLY CHANGES I MADE I used Double Stuff Oreos. Extra Creamy Oatmilk for the pudding ALSO LIKE many of posted, it is one cup milk per pudding package. After each layer, I had it sit in the freezer for a bit and served it very cold

Ok so I made this and it’s delicious but mine did not turn out how I thought it would! I used 2 cups of milk and followed the recipe EXACTLY how it says to complete each step. It was good but the kids called it cake soup. The pudding layer did not harden at all and was super runny! I am adding a pic of my plate. It was really good but I’d like to figure out where I went wrong and why it was so runny or why on earth the pudding never thickened? Will make again probably just to see if I can improve it lol

This was the best chocolate pie! My husband loved it.
Instead of two small boxes of pudding mix, I used one large box, and adjusted the milk accordingly. The perfect balance of flavors...not to sweet or rich..
I’ve made 3 of these pies in the past week and none of them have made it past 24 hrs in my house
Recipe was simple and delicious. Thanks.

Great and easy recipe! This pie was delicious and easy to make. I added crumbled Oreo crumbs for a little added decoration on top of mine. Didn’t change anything except maybe let set 6 hours instead of 4!
